decisions.reason: The click-in track adapter is the firm's flagship and extends its core track-lighting know-how, so the firm can interpret results and keep refining it.
The LED luminaire line sits close to the firm's established lighting expertise, though several years after launch individual models may be refreshed or replaced.
The home automation server box builds on the firm's existing control and automation offer, which supports assimilation, but fast-moving electronics carry a higher risk of being superseded.
The luminaire family had its own page and is close to the firm's core design and lighting knowledge, so management can manage and improve it, despite normal product-cycle replacement risk.
